experiment_title: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: GSM6383641: K562 PRO-seq NHS Homo sapiens OTHER
project_name: Transcriptional responses of cancer cells to heat shock-inducing stimuli involve amplification of robust HSF1 binding
study_title: Transcriptional responses of cancer cells to heat shock-inducing stimuli involve amplification of robust HSF1 binding
description: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: GSM6383641: K562 PRO-seq NHS Homo sapiens OTHER
library_construction_protocol: Precision Run-On sequencing (PRO-seq) was performed as previously described {Mahat et al., 2016}. Briefly, nuclei were extracted from ~2x107 cells and run-on reactions were carried on at 37°C for 3 minutes using 3ml of each 11-biotin-labelled ribonucleotide stocks (Perkin Elmer). Libraries were prepared as described in Mahat et al., 2016 using custom Illumina small RNA compatible linkers, alkaline degradation, enzymatic treatments and streptavidin selection of nascent RNA on magnetic beads according to the cited protocol.
